verdict.rationale: Gusto's public CLI supports headless/scripted operation (env-var tokens, CI-friendly, no interactive prompt) and ships bundled agent skills (cash-forecasting, timesheet-sync, payroll-prep) that auto-install into agent workspaces, enabling background-run automations for non-money-moving tasks. However, any write action (including payroll submission) is explicitly gated behind a --confirm human-in-the-loop step and the CLI has no run/submit command at all, so fully autonomous background execution of consequential tasks is intentionally blocked. Missing for 10: evidence of any workflow that runs fully autonomously end-to-end without a human confirmation gate, and independent/hands-on corroboration beyond the vendor's own repo.
